200.description: Committed service, artifact catalog and KCL-generated form schema

404.description: Service not found at the target revision

503.description: GitOps, artifact catalog or service schema unavailable

post.summary:
Refresh invalidates the previous validation; the new base must be reviewed
and explicitly validated before another publication.

400.description: Approval requires an open scheduled PR

404.description: Project, service, deployment, or run not found

204.description: Cancellation requested; cleanup may remain pending

404.description: Team, project or service not found

503.description: Identity service or committed access policy unavailable

403.description: Platform administrator and reviewed class required

409.description: Run or benchmark summary is incomplete or invalid
Runs or benchmark summaries are incomplete, invalid, or not comparable
Execution evidence, catalog or rollout policy does not match

303.description: Session revoked; redirect to the UI

ApprovalBinding.description:
Exact reviewed snapshot. The UI submits this unchanged, so an approval
cannot silently authorize a newer window, PR head, base, or policy.

observed_at.description: Timestamps are provenance, not a condition difference by themselves.

achieved_request_rate.description:
Upstream's observed request-start rate: recorded request count divided
by the time between first and last start, not the scheduled load rate.
Null when the upstream start span was unavailable or zero.

image.description: Digest-pinned adapter image from the persisted prepared Job.

BenchmarkStage.description: A stage repeats the corresponding configured load stage with its type.

BenchmarkWorkloadSpec.description:
This is the exact named workload object, including SLO thresholds. Numbers
are retained as JSON numbers so comparison does not normalize the spec.

ComparedConditions.description:
`changed` compares all conditions except `observed_at`. Both original
condition snapshots remain available, including their observation times.

run_revision_relation.description:
Run configuration digests are not Git commit IDs. These are recent
service runs, not evidence asserted to apply to either compared commit.

project_id.description: Required for admission; a missing or nil project ID is rejected.

DebugSessionResponse.description:
The same fields as the durable session, excluding internal initialization
claims and all Job credentials.

seed_accepted.description: The upstream seed was durably accepted; replies are permitted only then.

EvidenceIdentity.description:
Pinned identities, not merely tags or mutable PVC names. The producer must resolve
actual runtime identity and ensure its content manifests are immutable.

timestamp_ns.description: Unix timestamp in nanoseconds, as supplied by Loki.

NewArtifact.description:
Catalog intent for a new immutable packaged model. These administrator
declarations are reviewed in Git; they are not runtime evidence.

merge_observed_at.description: Local time at which the controller observed a merge response or merged PR.

merge_requested_at.description: Local time at which the controller requested the merge.

upstream_merged_at.description: Actual merge time reported by the forge, if available.

ServiceForm.description:
All form data describe the same immutable GitOps commit. `source` and
`artifacts` are committed YAML data expressed as JSON without added defaults.

artifacts.description:
Artifact name to the exact committed artifact object, including its URI
and any model/tokenizer content identities.

Workload.description: Parameters are deliberately numeric and bounded; neither command nor pod spec is user supplied.
